title: Google My Business: How To Contact Customer Support Phone Number and Email
description: Use the link below to fill out a request form and trigger an automatic callback. https://support.google.com/business/contact/business_c2c_m?from=cuf_c2c  When it comes to Google My Business, it can be difficult to reach customer support from Google.  In this video, I show you how to reach Google My Business customer support by phone, chat or email.  Google does not make it easy to contact their customer support, but we show you how to find it within the Google My Business dashboard.  Learn more about online marketing at http://3bugmedia.com   3bug Media is an online marketing company that helps small businesses generate more leads and sales online.   We create online marketing strategies that work. From SEO to PPC to Conversion Optimization and marketing automation, we offer our clients a full-service web marketing experience with an open communication style and full attention to detail.   Join us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/3bugmedia/ Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/3bugmedia Learn more about our local marketing programs: http://3bugmedia.com/local-business-marketing-services/ Learn more about our Digital Marketing Audits: http://3bugmedia.com/digital-marketing-audit/  -~-~~-~~~-~~-~- Please watch: "Why Local SEO Is Important For Your Small Business"  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kob-jvZR3Aw -~-~~-~~~-~~-~-

asr.full_text: Hey this is Gary from 3bug Media and today I'm going to show you how to get support for your Google my business listing. Now some people can find this but it can be a little bit tricky to try to actually be able to talk to somebody from Google when it comes to your Google my business listing. So I'm going to show you very quickly on how to find the area on this site where you can get phone support, email support, or even chat support. Okay, so the first thing you're going to do is once you're logged in to your Google My Business Listing account, you're going to scroll down to your location and you're going to click on manage location. Along the left here you're going to go down all the way to the bottom where it says support. You're going to click on support and this box is gonna open up on your right here okay you're gonna want to select and if you look here some of these actually a lot of these if you start clicking on them they don't they don't offer you the option to talk to Google they send you to continuous help Doc's so sometimes it could be a little frustrating trying to navigate and find the right one but what you're gonna do is you're gonna go to number three here you're gonna go to where it says fix incorrect business information on Google you're gonna click on that you're gonna get some text here and you're gonna scroll down to where it says keep in mind and right here it's gonna say contact support you're gonna click on support and you're gonna scroll down to the bottom here and it's going to say Need Help? Okay, and you're going to have three options here. You can request a call where you're going to enter your information, and I'm going to show you that in a second. You can do chat. Right now, this is a weekend when I'm filming, when I'm recording this, so chat's not available, or you can send an email and get a response. Okay? So we're going to request a callback. And when you click on that, you're going to fill out this form. It's going to ask you if you're the owner or you're an agency working with the business. They want to know who you are. Describe your issue. So you're just going to pick one of these options, what your issue is. So maybe you have an incorrect information in there you can't seem to correct, or somebody's taking control of your listing or something like that. You're just going to describe what your issue is and put your business name and address. You're going to put the URL on your google listing. Ok, all you do is go to google, type in your business and your city, copy the url in the search results and paste that in right here. Ok, so actually I'll do it for you so going to paste that in right here. okay? actually I'll do it for you, so we can see what it looks like. We're going to go to google.com, and we are going to type in ThreeBug Media Charlotte, North Carolina. And then we would just copy that URL and you see the listing shows up here on the right we're gonna copy that URL and we would just paste that in right there so they can see what your Google My Business listing is when they look at it. They're also gonna look they're also gonna ask you, how do you manage your listing if you would manage it through the Google my business dashboard or do you manage multiple locations or do you only manage it on your phone, okay? So once you fill that in, you're gonna click Next and it's gonna schedule a callback. So what's gonna happen after that is Google's gonna get your information and one of their tech support people will call you back. They usually, if you do this during business hours, they usually call you back within the hour. Just bear in mind that most of their tech support is overseas so sometimes language can be an issue. But I will say they are very good with their customer support when it comes to google my business and they usually always can solve your problem for you. So if you just have some patience and make sure you speak clearly when you're speaking to customers support so they understand you and just have a little bit of patience they are very helpful and they usually they will sort out your problem for you right away okay so hopefully it has helped and like I said I'll just show you one more time go to support fix incorrect business information go down here under keep in mind click support scroll down to the bottom and you're gonna have all these options right here to contact Google okay so hopefully this was helpful and hopefully you'll get the help that you need from google support okay thank you very much have a good day
